purpose: test whether daily-rank Ridge survives when lagged execution-quality proxies enter learning or the preopen candidate set

overlap.difference: G5 was previously tested as one block under positive-session raked logit; iteration 3 tests each column, nonlinear transforms and candidate screens under the newly discovered daily-rank Ridge objective. It does not claim four new raw data sources.

penalize sessions with no observed intraday range

threshold_policy: Every screen threshold is recalculated from rows strictly before the scoring month. No full-evaluation quantile or fixed threshold is allowed.
